vcu_g_0159_2000101e.name: lighting_level_bar_action_latch
vcu_g_0159_2000101e.description: One-shot latch for the low-level action of the level bar. vcu_level_bar_update_hysteresis sets it to 1 when the level is in the 5..9 percent band (it calls FUN_08001b64(2) once at that point) and clears it when the level is below 5 or above 9. vcu_0159_080047ac resets it to 0 on a mode change.

vcu_g_0159_2000101f.name: lighting_level_bar_empty_flag
vcu_g_0159_2000101f.description: Flag that is 1 while the requested level bar value is below 5 percent (bar empty). It is cleared when the level is 5 or above. While it is 1, the redraw at dither phase 60 also calls FUN_0800bee8. vcu_0159_080047ac resets it to 0.

vcu_g_0159_20001360.name: lighting_indicator_timeout_ticks
vcu_g_0159_20001360.description: Tick counter for the indicator sequence in vcu_0159_0800a5c8. It counts up each call and when it passes 300 (or when flag 0x20001f69 is 1) it re-arms the indicator (0x20001fa8 = 1) and returns to 0. vcu_double_pulse_indicator_step and the mode reset also clear it.

vcu_g_0159_20001368.name: lighting_blink_tick
vcu_g_0159_20001368.description: Tick within the 40-tick PC14/PC15 blink cycle of vcu_c14_c15_blink_step. The output is on for ticks 0..19 and off for 20..39. It runs while the blink request 0x20001fe8 is 10 and is cleared when that request is 11.

vcu_g_0159_20001372.name: lighting_double_pulse_step
vcu_g_0159_20001372.description: Step of the 55-tick double-pulse indicator in vcu_double_pulse_indicator_step. It runs only while flag 0x20001fbf is 1. The pulse is on for steps 0..14 and 35..54 and off for 15..34. At step 55 it wraps to 0 and sets the done flag 0x20001fa8.

vcu_g_148_20001442.name: lighting_sweep_state_b148
vcu_g_148_20001442.description: Build-148-only byte in the channel-sweep state block, used by vcu_channel_sweep_animation. The other builds keep the level-bar lower level at this offset (0x200014f6 in 0159), so this is an extra byte in the 148 layout. Its meaning is not established.

vcu_g_0159_200014f4.name: lighting_sweep_period
vcu_g_0159_200014f4.description: Sweep tick divider. vcu_channel_sweep_animation advances the sweep only when the frame counter lighting_sweep_frame_counter is a multiple of this value, so it must be non-zero. Its unit is probably animation ticks. It is set by the configuration and read only.

vcu_g_0159_200014f5.name: lighting_sweep_channel_count
vcu_g_0159_200014f5.description: Number of sweep channels (probably 10, one per LED channel 0..9). The sweep position runs from 0 to twice this value and then restarts. Read only by vcu_channel_sweep_animation.

vcu_g_0159_200014f6.name: lighting_level_bar
vcu_g_0159_200014f6.description: Level-bar dithering state at 0x200014f6..0x200014f8 (see the LightingLevelBar struct). Written by vcu_level_bar_update_hysteresis from the requested level and read back on each tick.

vcu_g_0159_20001505.name: lighting_brightness
vcu_g_0159_20001505.description: LED brightness state at 0x20001505..0x20001507 (see the LightingBrightness struct). Written by lighting_brightness_percent_set and read by the LED refresh code.

vcu_g_0159_20001510.name: lighting_sweep_state
vcu_g_0159_20001510.description: Channel-sweep state at 0x20001510..0x20001515 (see the LightingSweepState struct). Advanced by vcu_channel_sweep_animation once per sweep step.

vcu_g_0159_2000153e.name: lighting_fade_counter
vcu_g_0159_2000153e.description: Counter of the lighting fade ramp in lighting_fade_step. It increments each call and resets to 0 when it passes 50 (threshold 0x32); the reset issues the LED command codes 0x81 or 0x86 (probably the fade step command).

vcu_g_0159_200021cf.name: lighting_led_image_cf
vcu_g_0159_200021cf.description: LED/LCD image byte at 0x200021cf. Bit 0 is set or cleared by vcu_chan_mask_update, led_frame_set_group_all and related functions. Bit 4 is set or cleared by led_frame_set_cf_bit4. lcd_fb_set_mode_indicator selects one of four exclusive indicator bits in this byte. The image is probably sent to the LED and LCD driver.

vcu_g_0159_200021d3.name: lighting_led_image_d3
vcu_g_0159_200021d3.description: LED image byte at 0x200021d3 with single-bit outputs. Bit 2 is set or cleared by led_frame_set_d3_bit2 and bit 3 by lcd_fb_set_d3_bit3. led_frame_set_bit16 sets or clears one of the 16 output bits that span 0x200021d2..0x200021d3; the 0x200021d2 half is not described here.

vcu_g_0159_200021e0.name: lighting_sweep_frame_counter
vcu_g_0159_200021e0.description: Frame counter of the channel sweep. vcu_channel_sweep_animation increments it on each animation tick and the sweep steps when the old value is a multiple of lighting_sweep_period. It is reset to 0 when the sweep ends.
